{{Quote|No one leaves Belsavis. Not prisoners, not guards. We all serve life sentences.|Republic Marshall Kay Cavarat|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kay Cavarat''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Republic Marshall]] and the chief [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officer]] of the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We're in a crisis. There are over ten thousand prisoners running loose; most of the wardens are dead.|Kay Cavarat discussing the Imperial attack and prison riot|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
[[Republic Marshall]] Kay Cavarat was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was charged with the overall security of the [[Belsavis prison]] and reported only to the [[Senate Security Committee]]. She was in command of the prison [[Warden/Legends|wardens]] who directed the daily activities of various sections including the minimum security, high security, and maximum security areas. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sent an attack force to [[Invasion of Belsavis|invade]] the prison, Cavarat did her best to keep control of the prison. Many of her top wardens were killed and the guards had a hard time keeping control with prisoners staging continual riots. Cavarat requested help and [[Republic trooper]]s with the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] were sent to restore order and fight off an Imperial invasion. She also helped the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as the [[Voidhound]] track down the escaped [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ivory]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Fortunately, I was never looking for the kind of boy to bring home to mom.|Kay Cavarat|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
Marshall Cavarat was known to be a tough cop and ran the prison with brutal efficiency. Cavarat was also attracted to men who were more of the "bad boy" type and was more interested in one night stands than long relationships. However, underneath, Cavarat also had a soft heart though she hid it well. Cavarat was dedicated to her job and relished locking up criminals.

==Behind the scenes==
Kay Cavarat appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Cavarat is a Republic sided character throughout the [[Voidhound]]'s missions on Belsavis. She is also a possible love interest if smuggler is male.
